title: POPANE-P1 Temporal Alignment Signal-Validity Control
purpose: Test whether the R1 POPANE physiological feature pipeline contains temporally aligned valence information at all, so a negative incremental forecast cannot be dismissed solely as failed physiology extraction.

source.extraction: Reuse R1 file QC, anchors, predictor windows and physiology feature extraction exactly.

target.definition: Mean self-reported valence in [-5,-1] s at each anchor.
target.note: This overlaps the physiological predictor interval [-10,-1] s and is deliberately a concurrent/aligned signal-validity target, NOT a prospective forecasting endpoint.

predictors.real_model: time_norm + all R1 peripheral physiology features
predictors.shifted_model: time_norm + the same physiology features after deterministic circular temporal misalignment within each subject×segment.

shift_rule.offset: For n rows in a group, circularly shift all physiology-feature rows forward by floor(n/2), with minimum 2 anchors when n>=4. Groups with n<4 are excluded from this control only.
shift_rule.labels: Self-report target and time_norm stay fixed.
shift_rule.rationale: Preserves each person's segment-specific physiology distribution and much of its autocorrelation while breaking local alignment by roughly half a segment.

evaluation.generalization: Same deterministic 10 held-person folds crossed with held-segment labels as R1; training excludes held people AND held segment.
learners: Ridge with R1 training-only alpha tuning
metrics: delta_alignment = MAE(shifted)-MAE(aligned), positive favors true temporal alignment
delta_context = MAE(context)-MAE(aligned), positive means aligned physiology adds predictive information over time alone
evaluation.uncertainty: Participant-cluster bootstrap, 5000 replicates, paired at participant level.

decision_rules.ALIGNED_PHYSIOLOGY_SIGNAL_VALID: Both Ridge and HGB delta_alignment 95% CIs strictly above zero AND at least one learner delta_context 95% CI strictly above zero.
decision_rules.WEAK_OR_MODEL_SPECIFIC_SIGNAL: Only one learner has a strictly positive alignment CI or aligned physiology does not beat context.
decision_rules.NO_ALIGNMENT_SIGNAL: Neither learner has a strictly positive delta_alignment CI.

firewalls: This is a positive control, not evidence of causal physiology.
Because target and physiology windows overlap, it cannot be used as prospective forecasting evidence.
A positive control strengthens interpretation of R1 as an incremental-information failure rather than extraction failure.
A failed control requires weakening the external 'real signal yet no increment' wording, but does not erase R1 baseline-dominance itself.
